mapper.select: SELECT TASK_KEY AS task_key, TASK_NAME AS task_name, BEAN_NAME AS bean_name, ENABLED_YN AS enabled_yn, DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mod_dt FROM TB_STK_BATCH_TASK_DEF WHERE ENABLED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TASK_KEY

SELECT J.JOB_ID AS job_id, J.JOB_NAME AS job_name, J.TASK_KEY AS task_key, J.ENABLED_YN AS enabled_yn, J.TIMEZONE AS timezone, TO_CHAR(J.MAX_RUNTIME_SEC) AS max_runtime_sec, J.ALLOW_MANUAL_RUN_YN AS allow_manual_run_yn, J.DESCRIPTION AS description, NVL(R.RUNNING_YN, 'N') AS running_yn, NVL(R.STOP_REQUEST_YN, 'N') AS stop_request_yn, TO_CHAR(R.LOCK_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lock_at, TO_CHAR(R.LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_heartbeat_at, R.LOCK_OWNER AS lock_owner, R.CURRENT_EXEC_ID AS current_exec_id, TO_CHAR(J.LAST_START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_start_at, TO_CHAR(J.LAST_END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_end_at, J.LAST_RESULT_CODE AS last_result_code, J.LAST_RESULT_MSG AS last_result_msg, TO_CHAR(J.MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mod_dt FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF J LEFT JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME R ON R.JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID WHERE J.JOB_ID = #{job_id}

SELECT TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_ID) AS schedule_id, JOB_ID AS job_id, SCHEDULE_TYPE AS schedule_type, CRON_EXPR AS cron_expr, TO_CHAR(INTERVAL_SEC) AS interval_sec, WINDOW_START_HH24MI AS window_start_hh24mi, WINDOW_END_HH24MI AS window_end_hh24mi, MISFIRE_POLICY AS misfire_policy, ENABLED_YN AS enabled_yn, TO_CHAR(NEXT_RUN_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS next_run_at, TO_CHAR(LAST_EVAL_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_eval_at FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_SCHEDULE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}

SELECT TO_CHAR(PARAM_ID) AS param_id, JOB_ID AS job_id, PARAM_KEY AS param_key, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(PARAM_VALUE, 4000, 1) AS param_value, PARAM_TYPE AS param_type, REQUIRED_YN AS required_yn, MASKED_YN AS masked_yn, TO_CHAR(MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mod_dt FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_PARAM WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id} ORDER BY PARAM_KEY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF ( JOB_ID, JOB_NAME, TASK_KEY, ENABLED_YN, TIMEZONE, MAX_RUNTIME_SEC, ALLOW_MANUAL_RUN_YN, RUN_POLICY, DESCRIPTION, LAST_RESULT_CODE, LAST_RESULT_MSG, REG_DT, MOD_DT ) VALUES ( #{job_id}, #{job_name}, #{task_key}, #{enabled_yn}, #{timezone}, TO_NUMBER(#{max_runtime_sec}), #{allow_manual_run_yn}, 'SINGLETON', #{description}, 'NONE', 'CREATED', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_SCHEDULE T USING ( SELECT #{job_id} AS JOB_ID FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.JOB_ID = S.JOB_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{schedule_type}, T.CRON_EXPR = CASE WHEN #{cron_expr} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{cron_expr} END, T.INTERVAL_SEC = CASE WHEN #{interval_sec} = '0' THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(#{interval_sec}) END, T.WINDOW_START_HH24MI = CASE WHEN #{window_start_hh24mi} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{window_start_hh24mi} END, T.WINDOW_END_HH24MI = CASE WHEN #{window_end_hh24mi} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{window_end_hh24mi} END, T.MISFIRE_POLICY = #{misfire_policy}, T.ENABLED_YN = #{enabled_yn}, T.NEXT_RUN_AT = TO_DATE(#{next_run_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), T.LAST_EVAL_AT = TO_DATE(#{last_eval_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), T.MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SCHEDULE_ID, JOB_ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, CRON_EXPR, INTERVAL_SEC, WINDOW_START_HH24MI, WINDOW_END_HH24MI, MISFIRE_POLICY, ENABLED_YN, NEXT_RUN_AT, LAST_EVAL_AT, REG_DT, MOD_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_STK_BATCH_JOB_SCHEDULE.NEXTVAL, #{job_id}, #{schedule_type}, CASE WHEN #{cron_expr} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{cron_expr} END, CASE WHEN #{interval_sec} = '0' THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(#{interval_sec}) END, CASE WHEN #{window_start_hh24mi} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{window_start_hh24mi} END, CASE WHEN #{window_end_hh24mi} = '' THEN NULL ELSE #{window_end_hh24mi} END, #{misfire_policy}, #{enabled_yn}, TO_DATE(#{next_run_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{last_eval_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_PARAM ( PARAM_ID, JOB_ID, PARAM_KEY, PARAM_VALUE, PARAM_TYPE, REQUIRED_YN, MASKED_YN, REG_DT, MOD_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_STK_BATCH_JOB_PARAM.NEXTVAL, #{job_id}, #{param_key}, #{param_value}, #{param_type}, #{required_yn}, #{masked_yn}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME T USING (SELECT #{job_id} AS JOB_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.JOB_ID = S.JOB_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (JOB_ID, RUNNING_YN, STOP_REQUEST_YN, MOD_DT) VALUES (#{job_id}, 'N', 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME SET LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT = SYSDATE , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id} AND RUNNING_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME SET RUNNING_YN = 'N' , STOP_REQUEST_YN = 'N' , CURRENT_EXEC_ID = NULL , LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT = NULL , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME SET STOP_REQUEST_YN = 'Y' , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME SET STOP_REQUEST_YN = 'N' , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}

UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_SCHEDULE SET NEXT_RUN_AT = TO_DATE(#{next_run_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , LAST_EVAL_AT = TO_DATE(#{last_eval_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
mapper.select: SELECT J.JOB_ID AS job_id, J.JOB_NAME AS job_name, J.TASK_KEY AS task_key, J.ENABLED_YN AS enabled_yn, J.TIMEZONE AS timezone, TO_CHAR(J.MAX_RUNTIME_SEC) AS max_runtime_sec, J.ALLOW_MANUAL_RUN_YN AS allow_manual_run_yn, S.SCHEDULE_TYPE AS schedule_type, S.CRON_EXPR AS cron_expr, TO_CHAR(S.INTERVAL_SEC) AS interval_sec, S.WINDOW_START_HH24MI AS window_start_hh24mi, S.WINDOW_END_HH24MI AS window_end_hh24mi, S.MISFIRE_POLICY AS misfire_policy, S.ENABLED_YN AS schedule_enabled_yn, TO_CHAR(S.NEXT_RUN_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS next_run_at, NVL(R.RUNNING_YN, 'N') AS running_yn FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF J JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_SCHEDULE S ON S.JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_TASK_DEF T ON T.TASK_KEY = J.TASK_KEY LEFT JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME R ON R.JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID WHERE J.ENABLED_YN = 'Y' AND S.ENABLED_YN = 'Y' AND T.ENABLED_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(R.RUNNING_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND (S.NEXT_RUN_AT IS NULL OR S.NEXT_RUN_AT <= SYSDATE) ORDER BY S.NEXT_RUN_AT NULLS FIRST, J.JOB_ID

SELECT R.JOB_ID FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME R JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF J ON J.JOB_ID = R.JOB_ID WHERE R.RUNNING_YN = 'Y' AND R.LOCK_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(R.LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT, R.LOCK_AT) < (SYSDATE - (J.MAX_RUNTIME_SEC / (24*60*60)))
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BATCH_EXEC_LOG L SET END_AT = SYSDATE, STATUS = 'FAIL', ERROR_MSG = SUBSTR( CASE WHEN L.ERROR_MSG IS NULL OR TRIM(L.ERROR_MSG) = '' THEN 'AUTO_ABORT_STALE_RUNTIME' ELSE L.ERROR_MSG || ' / AUTO_ABORT_STALE_RUNTIME' END, 1, 2000 ) WHERE L.STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME R JOIN TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF J ON J.JOB_ID = R.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT JOB_ID, MAX( CASE WHEN UPPER(PARAM_KEY) IN ('MARKETGROUP', 'MKTCD', 'SOURCEMKTCD') THEN UPPER(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(PARAM_VALUE, 100, 1)) END ) AS MARKET_GROUP FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_PARAM GROUP BY JOB_ID ) P ON P.JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID WHERE R.RUNNING_YN = 'Y' AND R.LOCK_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(R.LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT, R.LOCK_AT) < (SYSDATE - (J.MAX_RUNTIME_SEC / (24*60*60))) AND ( L.EXEC_ID = R.CURRENT_EXEC_ID OR ( J.TASK_KEY = 'REC_SIGNAL_RUN' AND L.BATCH_ID LIKE 'BATCH_' || REPLACE(UPPER(J.TASK_KEY), '_RUN', '') || '_%' AND L.START_AT >= NVL(J.LAST_START_AT, R.LOCK_AT) AND ( P.MARKET_GROUP IS NULL OR INSTR(UPPER(L.BATCH_ID), '_' || P.MARKET_GROUP || '_') > 0 ) ) ) )

UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_RUNTIME R SET RUNNING_YN = 'N' , STOP_REQUEST_YN = 'N' , CURRENT_EXEC_ID = NULL , LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT = NULL , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE R.RUNNING_YN = 'Y' AND R.LOCK_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF J WHERE J.JOB_ID = R.JOB_ID AND NVL(R.LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT, R.LOCK_AT) < (SYSDATE - (J.MAX_RUNTIME_SEC / (24*60*60))) )
UPDATE TB_STK_BATCH_JOB_DEF SET LAST_START_AT = SYSDATE , LAST_RESULT_CODE = 'RUNNING' , LAST_RESULT_MSG = 'RUNNING' , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
mapper.select: SELECT TASK_KEY AS task_key, TASK_NAME AS task_name, BEAN_NAME AS bean_name, ENABLED_YN AS enabled_yn, PARAM_SCHEMA_JSON AS param_schema_json, DESCRIPTION AS description FROM TB_STK_BATCH_TASK_DEF WHERE TASK_KEY = #{task_key} AND ENABLED_YN = 'Y'
